At Ad-comm we build, protect and scale our clients’ brands by combining the rigor, strategic discipline and innovation-led approach of management consultancy with the creative and omnichannel executional expertise of a communications agency.
At Ad-comm we build, protect and scale our clients’ brands by combining the rigor, strategic discipline and innovation-led approach of management consultancy with the creative and omnichannel executional expertise of a communications agency.
Through our deep understanding of Japan & Asia, our global outlook, strategic expertise and incessantly creative spirit, we work closely with our clients to better develop and articulate their brand offering, strengthen their positioning and optimize their opportunities for success. Ultimately, we drive results by connecting with and compelling key audiences to action.
Our group is a collaborative entity of specialized communication companies that are integrated around the needs of our clients. A holistic understanding of our clients allows us to develop and execute seamless & cohesive strategies across channels, while providing the ease and agility of one-stop account management.

Headquartered in Tokyo and with presence in Shanghai and Hong Kong, our multi-cultural, multi-lingual team brings extensive cross-segment experience across Asia, The Americas, Europe and the Middle East. We look at our clients’ challenges & opportunities through multiple perspectives and provide solutions with maximum relevance and impact.

Brand Consultancy
At Brandvision we partner with our clients to create differentiated and authentic brands that inspire, build trust and forge action by key audiences across borders.
We act as an independent consultancy and also work in collaboration with our other group companies to ensure that our work across all communication channels maintains focus on the achieving holistic brand objectives.
We’re uniquely positioned with the linguistic, cultural, market and strategic expertise required to work in partnership with clients striving to bolster brand equity on a domestic as well as global scale.
Our strategies are founded on insights, deep market and industry knowledge combined with innovation and bold creativity. We work to define, develop, articulate and communicate brands, creating meaningful engagement across all channels.
Our global experience with leading Japanese and multinational brands across sectors allows us to harness the power of cross pollination, drawing on insights and learnings to design and deliver branding initiatives that create transformative outcomes.

Advertising & Media Agency
Successful communications are built on a clear understanding of the key challenges and goals, as well as an intimate knowledge of target audiences.
Ad-media provides strategic communication services that range from the identification and analysis of goals and issues, to solution development & execution. We are one of the select few independent agencies in Japan that is in a position to make direct media transactions across all media categories including targeted digital media planning & buying, SEM & SEO, SNS and programmatic as well as TV, radio and print.
Our multicultural, multilingual team fully utilizes an extensive network of global alliances for strategy development, creative production and marketing operations, providing our clients with the best possible globally informed and relevant communication solutions.

Experiential Marketing
We believe that the most inspiring and compelling way to encounter a brand is to experience it in a manner that engages the senses. At Ad-event we’re driven to execute events that create indelible impressions, valuable relationships and demonstrable ROI.
Our team conceptualizes, plans and produces events of every scale, with ideas that drive engagement beyond the event through integrated online and offline channels.
We’ve worked with some of the world’s leading brands to combine our strategic and creative approach with best in class on-the-ground execution including artistic direction, innovative audio-visual elements and stage performances.

Digital & Social Media Marketing
Our Cybermedia team understands the digital customer journey and designs engaging & compelling user interfaces and experiences that increase brand awareness & revenues.
Holistic online marketing approaches seamlessly link online and offline brand experiences, leveraging impactful web & app development, content creation, social media campaigns, SEM & SEO, and platform optimization across devices.
We never stop mapping & calibrating the online brand journey and offering our clients market knowledge to keep innovating on digital platforms.

At Trimedia we build our clients’ unique stories and get them heard, and amplified by influencers, advocates and the media.
We deliver on the premise that today’s audiences seek to assess brands on their own terms; we craft strategies employing paid, earned and owned media to captivate, engage and motivate stakeholders to act.
Our entrepreneurial drive takes us beyond the conventional; we seek bold new ideas and deliver them through integrated online and offline campaigns. Our ideas are fueled by our market insights and leveraged through trusted, long-term relationships with thought leaders, business partners and the media.

Creative Lab
We’re strategically driven and creatively led. We’re thinkers and doers, dreamers and creators. Our Creative Lab brings together diverse backgrounds with a common mission to ignite spark, excite emotions and compel key audiences to react and act.
Our award winning work spans the globe across business sectors and touchpoints. Our clients are small and large brands, new brands and some of the world’s leading brands. What we do doesn’t change. Starting with insights, we create lasting impressions that stir the soul, moving the hearts and minds of intended audiences.
Our Creative Lab is fully integrated, and works collaboratively, across the entire Ad-comm Group.
